evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and modifies Guix release build scripts, manifests, and glibc patches under contrib/guix/.
rationale: Compiles official Linux release binaries as static position-independent executables (`-static-pie`), expanding distribution portability to non-glibc systems like Alpine Linux, NixOS, and older glibc distributions. As stated in the description, binaries 'can now be run on non-glibc based systems, as well as on systems that ship with older glibcs' and unblocks security enhancements like aarch64 pointer authentication (#19075).
